page.content:
Lane Locke is one of the veteran racers competing in the Piston Cup. He is sponsored by SynerG and is number 5. However, sometime during the 2016 season, he gets fired by SynerG and gets replaced by Eric Braker.

page.overview:
Who is Lane Locke?

Lane Locke is one of the veteran racers competing in the Piston Cup. He is sponsored by SynerG and is number 5. However, sometime during the 2016 season, he gets fired by SynerG and gets replaced by Eric Braker.
